subject: You are the lead investigator — {incidentRef}
preheader: An incident investigation on {productName} has been assigned to you.
body:
You have been appointed lead investigator for incident {incidentRef} ({incidentTitle}) on {productName}.

Start the investigation from the incident page: gather evidence and witness statements while they are fresh, work the root-cause analysis, and submit your conclusion for approval when it is defensible.
footer: You are receiving this because a manager appointed you lead investigator in {productName}.
